title: OnlyFans Millionaires: Site Says 5,076 Creators Have Earned More Than $1 Million to Date
content: A sizable bunch of top OnlyFans creators have taken home seven-figure checks from the fan-monetization site. Since the 2016 launch of OnlyFans, which is known for its porn-friendly policies, 5,076 creators have made over $1 million on the platform, the company said Tuesday.
